_meta.note: Photo Cull UI strings. Keys are shared by all languages; keep {placeholders} unchanged.

common.link_expired: This link has expired. Please run the launcher again.

cull.title: Photo Cull
cull.open_edit_tip: Open Photo Edit in a new tab (run the 启动编辑 launcher first)

folder.title: Photo folder
folder.placeholder: Choose or paste a folder path
folder.pair_hint: RAW files (DNG/ARW/RAF…) and JPEGs with the same name in the same folder are paired automatically and rated, labeled and deleted together.
folder.load_prev: Load the last results for this folder

mode.title: Mode
mode.ai_hint: Local analysis first removes failed shots and burst duplicates; only shortlisted photos are sent, downsized, to the chosen model to judge composition, light and moment.
mode.local_hint: Technical checks only. Runs entirely on this computer: no network, no cost.

ai.base_url_hint: Enter the provider’s OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. Qwen https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1, Kimi https://api.moonshot.ai/v1, OpenRouter https://openrouter.ai/api/v1. The model must accept images.
ai.model_other_hint: Type any other model name from this provider. It must accept image input.
ai.model_custom_hint: Use the model name from the provider’s docs. It must be a vision model.
ai.key_env: Environment variable {env} detected; you can leave this empty.
ai.key_console: Get one at {console}. Billed per use, separate from any chat subscription.
ai.key_custom: Enter the provider’s API key (or set the {env} environment variable).
ai.remember_hint: Saved in ~/.photo-cull, readable only by you
ai.lang_hint: AI comments are written in the interface language (switch it at the top right).

model_note.ds_vision: DeepSeek’s only model with image input

out.title: Output
out.xmp_hint: RAW files get an XMP sidecar that Lightroom Classic / Capture One can read
out.embed_hint: Lets Lightroom show ratings on JPEGs too. Only metadata changes; image data is verified byte for byte afterwards
out.xmp_all: Write XMP sidecars for standalone JPEG/HEIC too
out.xmp_all_hint: For Capture One; Lightroom ignores sidecars for JPEGs
out.dry_hint: Only builds the report: no ratings written, no files organized. Recommended for the first run

org.title: Organize output
org.enable: Organize into an output folder after rating
org.enable_hint: You can also leave this off and click “Organize by current ratings” after reviewing the report
org.copy_hint: The original folder stays untouched; the output folder holds a copy (needs twice the space). Organizing again updates that copy instead of copying twice.
org.move_hint: Photos are moved out of the original folder. Photos already imported into Lightroom / Capture One will show as missing and need to be relocated there.
org.by_result_hint: Rejected = photos marked reject (X); everything else is kept
org.by_format: Then split each into JPEG / RAW
org.rename_hint: Only files in the output folder are renamed; originals keep their names
org.move_confirm: Move mode takes the photos out of the original folder and puts them in the output folder. Continue?

adv.title: Advanced
adv.hint: Sharp photos flagged as blurry → raise both blur thresholds. Shots of one scene not grouped → increase “Scene gap” or lower “Scene similarity”.

empty.title: Choose a folder to start culling
empty.body: Supports RAW such as Leica/Panasonic DNG, Sony ARW and Fujifilm RAF, plus JPG/HEIC/PNG. Same-name RAW+JPEG are paired automatically. Image data is never altered.
empty.s1_body: Focus, exposure, faces and closed eyes, burst grouping. Free
empty.s2_body: Optional: Claude / ChatGPT / Grok / Gemini / DeepSeek or a custom endpoint. Only shortlisted photos, with a usage estimate before any call
empty.s3_body: Change ratings and delete rejects in the report, RAW and JPEG together; sort into folders by rating and rename

done.note_dry: Dry run: ratings were not written in bulk. Ratings you change in the report are written immediately.
done.note_xmp: Ratings written for {n} photos. In Lightroom, run Metadata → Read Metadata from Files.
done.note_none: Ratings were not written in bulk.
done.org_dry: Dry run: would have {verb} {n} photos to {out}.

confirm.title: Confirm AI review
confirm.line: {n} shortlisted photos will be sent to {model}.
confirm.cache_hint: Photos reviewed before come from the cache and are not charged again. Your provider’s bill is authoritative.

err.no_folder: Please choose a photo folder first
err.need_key: An API key is required for {name} review
err.custom_incomplete: A custom endpoint needs both a base URL and a model name

msg.need_opencv: OpenCV is missing: pip install -r requirements.txt
msg.need_rawpy: This RAW has no readable preview; rawpy is required: pip install rawpy
msg.need_heif: Reading HEIC/HIF requires pillow-heif: pip install pillow-heif
msg.no_key: {env} ({name} API key) is not set. See the README.
msg.ai_no_json: The model did not return JSON
msg.ai_all_cached: AI review: all {n} photos found in the cache, no cost.
msg.ai_jobs: AI review: {n} photos will be sent to {label} ({cached} more found in the cache).
msg.ai_ask: Call the API? Type y to confirm:
msg.ai_stop: {n} calls in a row failed, so AI review was stopped. Check {env}, the model name and your account balance.
msg.no_photos: No supported photos in this folder.
msg.start: {n} photos ({files} files, {pairs} RAW+JPEG pairs). Starting local analysis…
msg.kept_manual: Kept the manually adjusted ratings of {n} photos from last time.
msg.trash_ask: Move {n} rejected photos (with paired files) to the Trash? Type y to confirm:
msg.org_kept_state: The output folder {out} stays as it was last organized. To reorganize by the new ratings, turn on “Organize output” or click “Organize by current ratings” on the report page.
msg.org_dry: Dry run: would have {verb} {n} photos ({files} files) to {out}; nothing was changed.
msg.result: Result: {candidate} shortlisted, {alt} burst alternates, {reject} rejected, {error} unreadable; {top} rated 4★ or higher; {pairs} RAW+JPEG pairs.
msg.dry_xmp: Dry run: would have written ratings for {n} photos; nothing was written.
msg.xmp_done: Ratings written for {n} photos (RAW → XMP sidecar).
msg.xmp_done_embed: Ratings written for {n} photos (RAW → XMP sidecar, JPEG → embedded XMP).

parse.raf_preview_pos: RAF embedded preview is out of place
parse.raf_preview_jpeg: RAF embedded preview is not a JPEG
parse.jpeg_no_scan: No image data found in the JPEG
parse.jpeg_mpf: Not enough XMP space in this JPEG and it sits after MPF data; left unchanged to protect the file
parse.verify_changed: Verification failed: image data would change, so nothing was written
parse.verify_decode: Verification failed: the file could not be decoded after writing ({err}); nothing was written
parse.xmp_too_big: XMP is too large for a single JPEG segment

peer.title: {name} is not running
peer.head: “{name}” is not running
peer.body: Double-click {cmd} in the tool folder, wait for it to open in your browser, then come back and click Retry.

server.cancelled: Cancelled. Finished AI reviews are cached and won’t be charged again.
server.no_result: There are no cull results yet
server.no_prev: This folder has no results yet. Run a cull first

choose.photos: Choose the photo folder to cull
choose.unavailable: A folder picker isn’t available on this system. Please paste the path.

server.busy_mark: Culling in progress; try again when it finishes
server.busy_trash: Culling in progress; try deleting when it finishes
server.busy_org: Culling in progress; organize when it finishes
server.only_current_save: Only the photo that is currently open can be saved
server.only_current_export: Only the photo that is currently open can be exported
server.close_hint: Close this terminal window to quit.

flag.eyes: Eyes may be closed / face turned

report.title: Photo Cull Report
report.mode_edit: Change ratings or select photos to delete here; changes are written to both the RAW and the JPEG of each pair
report.mode_static: Ratings and labels are in the XMP; review them in Lightroom / Capture One
report.trash_body:
{files} files (including paired RAW/JPEG) and their XMP will be moved to the {trash}, where you can restore them.

If these photos are already in a Lightroom / Capture One catalog, they will show as missing there; remove them in that app too.

edit.title: Photo Edit
edit.open_cull_tip: Open Photo Cull in a new tab (run the 启动筛选 launcher first)

files.from_cull_tip: Open the folder Photo Cull processed most recently
files.empty: Choose a photo folder. Supports Leica/Panasonic DNG, all Sony ARW, and JPG/HEIC/TIFF.
files.none: No supported photos in this folder

bar.reset_confirm: Reset all adjustments for this photo?

empty.title: Edit
empty.body: Pick a photo on the left. Adjustments are saved automatically and the original file is never modified; when you’re done, use Export on the right.

view.zoom_tip: Click to zoom to 1:1 screen pixels; click again to fit

vig.title: Lens vignetting (simulates optical falloff without in-camera correction)
vig.note: {level} ≈ {stop} · corners about {ev} EV darker than the center

global.name: Evaluative (whole frame)
global.desc: Zone-based evaluation of the whole frame, targeting 18% gray. Neutral tone: moderate black and white points, contrast unchanged

leica_cw.name: Leica classic center-weighted
leica_cw.desc: M-body style center-weighted metering, about 1/4 EV below 18% gray. Deep tone: deep blacks, stronger contrast, dark scenes only partly lifted

leica_global.name: Leica multi-field +0.3 EV
leica_global.desc: Leica multi-field (whole frame) metering plus +0.3 EV compensation. Leica tone, but airier

fuji_cw.name: Fujifilm center-weighted
fuji_cw.desc: Wider center area than Leica, targeting 18% gray. Soft tone: slightly lifted blacks, gentle transitions, bright midtones, stricter highlight protection

hdr.name: HDR dynamic metering
hdr.desc: Exposes for the highlights (almost no clipping), then lifts Shadows and pulls down Highlights. For high-contrast scenes

auto.hdr: Exposure {v} · Shadows {s} · Highlights {h} (about {dr} EV of range)

curve.title: Curves
curve.hint: Click to add a point, drag to adjust, double-click to delete

lib.root_tip: Leave empty or “(built-in)” for the bundled LUTs
lib.add_tip: Add your own .cube files to “My LUTs” (multiple allowed)
lib.empty: Once the library loads, click a LUT to apply it.
lib.note: LUTs are designed for the sRGB look of Sony “ST” / Leica “STD”: shoot JPEGs in ST/STD; for RAW, the editor’s standard rendering approximates that look.
lib.truncated: Too many files; only the first 8,000 are listed

export.title: Export
export.hint: Exports go to a photo-cull-export subfolder next to the photo; the original is never overwritten.

err.cube_invalid: Not a valid .cube file (missing LUT_3D_SIZE / LUT_1D_SIZE)
err.remove_own: Only LUTs you added can be removed

warn.log_disabled: This LUT is for camera Log footage and Log conversion isn’t enabled yet; applied as sRGB, colors will be off
warn.print_lut: This is a film print LUT meant to follow a negative LUT; on its own the colors will be off
warn.other_log: This LUT is for another camera’s Log footage, which the editor doesn’t support yet; colors will be off
warn.negative_lut: This is a film negative LUT: it outputs a negative and needs a print LUT after it for a normal image
warn.look_missing: The look “{name}” referenced by this preset wasn’t found (keep it in the same set of folders as the preset)
warn.look_jpeg_only: This look is designed for JPEG only (Lightroom won’t apply it to RAW); results on RAW may be off
warn.look_raw_only: This look is designed for RAW only (Lightroom won’t apply it to JPEG); colors on JPEG may be clearly off. Use the JPG version from the same set
warn.no_rawpy: rawpy is not installed, so you’re editing the RAW’s embedded preview (8-bit, limited latitude). Run the 安装环境 script to add it.
warn.raw_failed: RAW decoding failed ({err}); editing the embedded preview with limited latitude.
